killedBy: boot: nothing starts until the player asks (issue #428) leaves the shell standing when the cause is transient
why: Sends every failure back down the page path, which is what shipped before issue #325's ruling: a match that fails for a transient reason wipes a Main Menu that is working perfectly and tells the player to reload. Note what does NOT catch it -- the failure is still announced, the copy is still classified correctly, the error still reaches `reportError`, and every assertion about WHAT is said passes unchanged. The only observable difference is whether the root was emptied, which is why the killing case plants a marker element in the shell and checks it survives rather than asserting on the ledger.
